Helium D.,

Hello Vyacheslav,

I'm sorry. You've asked about this five times now and we left you without a proper answer, and that is our failure.

Here is exactly where Shop···· stands today. It was placed on September 27, it is paid in full at $536.00, and nothing has shipped. Both NEXUS QX1 units and the Harlo OS add-on are still open, there is no booking at the warehouse for them, and I do not have a ship date I can stand behind. I am not going to give you another one that moves.

You have asked for the order to be cancelled and the money returned to the card you paid with. Cancelling is not something we do as a matter of course, so the request has to be reviewed by a supervisor, and I have put it in front of them now with your full history on it. I can't decide the amount or the timing myself, and I won't promise you something I don't control.

Our team is offline for the evening. They are back tomorrow at 10am Eastern and this is at the top of their list, and the answer comes to you by reply in this thread, so there is nothing more you need to send us.

Thank you for your patience with us on this.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
